The structure of CoGeS is tetragonal with space group I4_122 (No. 143) and a unit cell of Co4Ge4S4 containing 12 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 9 geometric neighbors, Ge centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 neighbors, and S centers with 10 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and Ge polyhedra, as well as edge sharing between Co and S and between Ge and S polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
